OVERVIEW

Qatar Football Association was established in the 1960’s; it’s a private organization with public interest and its Governing the body of Football in the Sate of Qatar. QFA plays a pivotal role in laying the foundation for football in the state, and is still the first to help advance the game and improve its level in Qatar.

QFA defines supplier collaboration as the joint development of capabilities for the purposes of process improvements, and innovation in services. Therefore, a supplier may serve as an external source for innovation, by communicating clearly, sharing Knowledge and creating atmosphere of trust
